```{python}
#| label: fig-fp6-system
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Radio architecture of the Fairphone (Gen. 6), simplified from the published schematics. RF signals are drawn in black, digital data interfaces in blue, control buses in green, and PA supplies in red."
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
ax.set_xlim(0, 20)
ax.set_ylim(0, 12.7)
ax.axis('off')

def box(x, y, w, h, title, sub='', fc='white', fs=9):
    """Rounded box with a bold title and an optional subtitle (e.g., part numbers)."""
    ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((x, y), w, h, boxstyle='round,pad=0.02,rounding_size=0.18',
                                fc=fc, ec='#444444', lw=1.1))
    if sub:
        ax.text(x + w / 2, y + h / 2 + 0.1, title, ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=fs, weight='bold')
        ax.text(x + w / 2, y + h / 2 - 0.05, sub, ha='center', va='top', fontsize=fs - 1.5,
                color='#444444', linespacing=1.3)
    else:
        ax.text(x + w / 2, y + h / 2, title, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fs, weight='bold')
    return x, y, w, h

def arrow(p0, p1, color='k', both=False):
    ax.annotate('', xy=p1, xytext=p0,
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='<|-|>' if both else '-|>', color=color, lw=1.2,
                                shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0, mutation_scale=9))

def line(xs, ys, color='k'):
    ax.plot(xs, ys, color=color, lw=1.2, solid_capstyle='butt')

c_fe, c_mod, c_rfic, c_soc, c_pwr = '#eeeeee', '#fde9c8', '#cfe2f3', '#d9ead3', '#f4cccc'

# column x positions and widths
X_ANT, W_ANT = 0.1, 2.2
X_SW, W_SW = 2.8, 2.1
X_FLT, W_FLT = 5.6, 2.1
X_MOD, W_MOD = 8.3, 3.7
X_TRX, W_TRX = 12.8, 2.7
X_SOC, W_SOC = 16.7, 3.1

# passive front-end (antennas, switches, filters) spans the full height
box(X_ANT, 0.4, W_ANT, 11.0, '11 antenna\nfeeds', '2 with tuners\n(QAT5618)', fc=c_fe)
box(X_SW, 0.4, W_SW, 11.0, 'diplexers\ntriplexers\nswitches', '', fc=c_fe)
box(X_FLT, 1.9, W_FLT, 9.5, 'SAW/BAW\nfilters,\nduplexers,\nquadplexer,\ncouplers', '', fc=c_fe)
for y in (2.6, 6.0, 9.6):
    arrow((X_ANT + W_ANT, y), (X_SW, y), both=True)
for y in (3.2, 6.0, 9.6):
    arrow((X_SW + W_SW, y), (X_FLT, y), both=True)

# active front-end modules, one row each
rows = {   # name: (y, h, title, subtitle)
    'lna':  (9.0, 2.4, 'LNA modules', 'LB PRX (QLN5020)\nLB + MHB DRX (QLN5030)\nMHB PRX (QLN5040)'),
    'uhb':  (6.5, 1.9, 'n77/n78 modules', 'PA + LNA (QPM2980)\nDRX/MIMO (QDM3980)'),
    'pa':   (4.45, 1.7, 'PA modules', '2 multimode PAs (MMPA)\nGSM PA (QPA2625)'),
    'gnss': (1.9, 1.15, 'GNSS L1/L5', 'SAW + LNA + SAW'),
}
mods = {k: box(X_MOD, y, W_MOD, h, t, sub, fc=c_mod) for k, (y, h, t, sub) in rows.items()}
apt = box(X_MOD + 0.4, 3.45, W_MOD - 0.8, 0.6, '2 APT (QET3930)', '', fc=c_pwr, fs=8)

def mid(k):
    x, y, w, h = mods[k]
    return y + h / 2

arrow((X_FLT + W_FLT, mid('lna')), (X_MOD, mid('lna')))
arrow((X_FLT + W_FLT, mid('uhb')), (X_MOD, mid('uhb')), both=True)
arrow((X_MOD, mid('pa')), (X_FLT + W_FLT, mid('pa')))
arrow((X_FLT + W_FLT, mid('gnss')), (X_MOD, mid('gnss')))
arrow((apt[0] + apt[2] / 2, apt[1] + apt[3]), (apt[0] + apt[2] / 2, mods['pa'][1]), color='tab:red')

# transceivers and SoC
box(X_TRX, 1.9, W_TRX, 9.5, 'SDR735', 'cellular RFIC\n\n4 RX paths\n2 TX chains\nfeedback RX\nGNSS RX', fc=c_rfic, fs=10)
box(X_TRX, 0.2, W_TRX, 1.3, 'WCN6755', 'Wi-Fi 6E, BT 5.4', fc=c_rfic)
box(X_SOC, 0.2, W_SOC, 11.2, 'SM7635', 'SoC\n\nmodem\n+\napplication\nprocessor', fc=c_soc, fs=10)

arrow((X_MOD + W_MOD, mid('lna')), (X_TRX, mid('lna')))
arrow((X_MOD + W_MOD, mid('uhb')), (X_TRX, mid('uhb')), both=True)
arrow((X_TRX, mid('pa')), (X_MOD + W_MOD, mid('pa')))
arrow((X_MOD + W_MOD, mid('gnss')), (X_TRX, mid('gnss')))

# Wi-Fi/BT RF path below the cellular front-end
arrow((X_SW + W_SW, 0.85), (X_TRX, 0.85), both=True)
ax.text((X_FLT + X_MOD + W_MOD) / 2, 0.95, 'Wi-Fi/BT RF (2.4 GHz, 5 GHz, 6 GHz)', fontsize=7.5,
        ha='center', va='bottom')

# digital interfaces and control buses
arrow((X_TRX + W_TRX, 7.0), (X_SOC, 7.0), color='tab:blue', both=True)
ax.text((X_TRX + W_TRX + X_SOC) / 2, 7.1, 'QLink', fontsize=8, ha='center', va='bottom', color='tab:blue')
arrow((X_TRX + W_TRX, 0.85), (X_SOC, 0.85), color='tab:blue', both=True)
ax.text((X_TRX + W_TRX + X_SOC) / 2, 0.95, 'PCIe', fontsize=8, ha='center', va='bottom', color='tab:blue')
c_ctl = 'tab:green'
x_bus = X_TRX + W_TRX / 2
x_tap = (X_MOD + W_MOD + X_TRX) / 2
y_bus = 11.7

# RFIC control of the switches and all active front-end modules
line([x_bus, x_bus, X_SW + W_SW / 2], [11.4, y_bus, y_bus], color=c_ctl)
arrow((X_SW + W_SW / 2, y_bus), (X_SW + W_SW / 2, 11.4), color=c_ctl)
arrow((X_MOD + W_MOD / 2, y_bus), (X_MOD + W_MOD / 2, 11.4), color=c_ctl)
line([x_tap, x_tap], [y_bus, apt[1] + apt[3] / 2], color=c_ctl)
for k in ('uhb', 'pa'):
    arrow((x_tap, mid(k) + 0.5), (X_MOD + W_MOD, mid(k) + 0.5), color=c_ctl)
arrow((x_tap, apt[1] + apt[3] / 2), (apt[0] + apt[2], apt[1] + apt[3] / 2), color=c_ctl)
ax.plot([x_tap, x_tap, x_tap, X_MOD + W_MOD / 2], [y_bus, mid('uhb') + 0.5, mid('pa') + 0.5, y_bus],
        'o', color=c_ctl, ms=3)
ax.text((x_bus + X_MOD + W_MOD / 2) / 2, y_bus + 0.05, 'MIPI RFFE + GPIO control', fontsize=7.5,
        ha='center', va='bottom', color=c_ctl)

# SoC control of the antenna tuners, the RFIC, and the GNSS LNAs
x_tun = X_ANT + W_ANT / 2
line([X_SOC + W_SOC / 2, X_SOC + W_SOC / 2, x_tun], [11.4, 12.2, 12.2], color=c_ctl)
arrow((x_tun, 12.2), (x_tun, 11.4), color=c_ctl)
ax.text((x_tun + X_SOC + W_SOC / 2) / 2, 12.25, 'MIPI RFFE to antenna tuners', fontsize=7.5,
        ha='center', va='bottom', color=c_ctl)
arrow((X_SOC, 9.0), (X_TRX + W_TRX, 9.0), color=c_ctl)
ax.text((X_TRX + W_TRX + X_SOC) / 2, 9.1, 'RFFE', fontsize=8, ha='center', va='bottom', color=c_ctl)
line([X_SOC, x_tap, x_tap], [1.7, 1.7, 2.2], color=c_ctl)
arrow((x_tap, 2.2), (X_MOD + W_MOD, 2.2), color=c_ctl)
ax.text((X_TRX + W_TRX + X_SOC) / 2, 1.75, 'GPIO', fontsize=8, ha='center', va='bottom', color=c_ctl)

# Wi-Fi switch control
arrow((X_TRX, 0.5), (X_SW + W_SW, 0.5), color=c_ctl)
ax.text((X_FLT + X_MOD + W_MOD) / 2, 0.45, 'GPIO', fontsize=7.5, ha='center', va='top', color=c_ctl)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
